heading: INT. FUNICULAR CAR - ALPINE CLIMB - NIGHT

units.text: INT. FUNICULAR CAR - ALPINE CLIMB - NIGHT
A glass cabin crawls up a mountain in the dark, a cable humming overhead and the lights of a casino resort burning at the summit like a held breath.
SABINE LACROIX (30s, black gloves, a champagne flute she hasn't touched) sits with her back to the glass.
Across from her TEODORO "TEO" BIANCHI (40s, bow tie loose, a briefcase cuffed to his wrist) stares at the floor.
A figure in a gray coat leans in the corner, face lost in the shadow of a hat: THE MAN IN GRAY.
From a speaker above the door, a bored VOICE of the operator drones through the static.
Next stop, Summit Station. Please remain seated until the car has come to a complete halt.
units.name: OPERATOR

units.text: Fourteen minutes. The vault door cycles at the quarter hour. Teo takes the case through the service lift, I take the lobby, and our friend in gray makes the cameras blink.
units.name: SABINE

units.text: You say that like it's simple.
units.name: TEO

units.text: It is simple. It's only terrifying.
units.name: SABINE

units.text: My cameras blink for ninety seconds. Not ninety-one.
units.name: THE MAN IN GRAY

units.text: Then we move in eighty.
units.name: SABINE

units.text: And if the guard on the service lift is the new one? The one who doesn't take bribes?
units.name: TEO

units.text: Then Teo recites the wine list until he cries.
units.name: SABINE

units.text: That is not funny.
units.name: TEO

units.text: Halvard.
units.name: THE MAN IN GRAY

units.text: What?
units.name: SABINE

units.text: My name. If we're doing this, you should have it. Halvard.
units.name: HALVARD

units.text: Halvard. Fine. Eighty seconds, Halvard.
units.name: SABINE

units.text: Summit Station in one minute.
units.name: OPERATOR

units.text: One minute.
units.name: TEO

units.text: Breathe, Teo.
units.name: SABINE

units.text: Gloves on.
units.name: HALVARD
